A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' who was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Unidentified air rodeo owner|woman]] who was the owner of a [[Unidentified traveling air rodeo|traveling air rodeo]] that used [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]]. At some point, his wife was captured by an [[Unidentified animal rights group|animal rights group]] who planned to starve her to bring about end of the use of thrantas in traveling [[air rodeo]]s.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Unidentified air rodeo owner|woman]] at some point in his life. Sometime after he had been married, his wife, who owned a [[Unidentified traveling air rodeo|traveling air rodeo]] that used [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]], was kidnapped by an [[Unidentified animal rights group|animal rights group]] who planned to starve his wife for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] to show her how the large, winged thrantas nearly starved during transport. The group's goal was to end the use of thrantas in traveling [[air rodeo]]s; they did not merely want the man to pay a ransom.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{RPGseed}}
After his wife was captured, a group of known individuals in the vicinity was called in to rescue her. The man was willing to pay the individuals for their work in rescuing his wife.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The husband of an air rodeo owner first appeared as part of an adventure idea in ''[[Rodeo Thranta]]'', an article written by [[Jeff Quick]] as part of the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' series of articles for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]]. The article was released on [[December]] [[December 12|12]], [[2002]], with the adventure ideas and characters being usable by gamemasters at any time after thrantas were first used in air rodeos, which happened before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the thrantas [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The man will offer to pay the player characters for rescuing his wife if they are hesitant about doing so.<ref name="Rodeo" />
